title: Add nonblocking desktop capture notifications
description:
Add a notification service that sends desktop notifications for capture lifecycle events (capture started, capture stopped, capture error) without blocking the capture pipeline or PipeWire realtime callback.

Before editing, inspect:
- src/ui/CaptureViewModel.hpp and src/ui/CaptureViewModel.cpp for capture state signals and current capture lifecycle handling
- src/audio/CaptureSession.hpp for session state transitions (Capturing, Stopped, Error) that drive notifications
- Any existing notification or system-tray code under src/

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Implementation:
1. Create src/ui/NotificationService.hpp declaring a NotificationService class with slots for onCaptureStarted(QString sourceName), onCaptureStopped(QString filePath, double durationSecs), onCaptureError(QString errorMessage). Use QSystemTrayIcon or freedesktop org.freedesktop.Notifications D-Bus interface for delivery.
2. Create src/ui/NotificationService.cpp implementing nonblocking notification delivery. Notifications must never block the calling thread. Use queued signal-slot connections if invoked from a non-GUI thread. Include a user-visible setting to disable notifications (expose as Q_PROPERTY enabled).
3. Modify src/ui/CaptureViewModel.cpp to instantiate NotificationService and connect capture lifecycle signals to it. Ensure connections use Qt::QueuedConnection so the PipeWire realtime callback is never blocked.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: src/ui/NotificationService.hpp exists and declares NotificationService with onCaptureStarted, onCaptureStopped, onCaptureError slots
src/ui/NotificationService.cpp exists and sends desktop notifications via QSystemTrayIcon or D-Bus
Notification delivery is nonblocking: no synchronous I/O or blocking calls in notification slots
NotificationService exposes a Q_PROPERTY enabled for user-controllable notification toggle
src/ui/CaptureViewModel.cpp connects capture signals to NotificationService using Qt::QueuedConnection
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify any PipeWire realtime callback code
add blocking synchronization in notification delivery

allowed: choose QSystemTrayIcon vs D-Bus for notification delivery
choose notification text and icon content
forbidden: introduce a notification queue or persistence layer
